He intentionally bumped into you, dropping his phone causing it to crack. He looked up at you with a mean look. “What the hell man? You’ve gotta pay me back for this, right?” Lopunny said, his brown fur illuminated in an alluring way. Unlucky for you, you left your wallet at home! You explained that to Lopunny. “Well then, you better take me to your home so I can get the money.” His once hostile tone gone, he lightly smiled. It was clear that he just wanted to go to your home for some reason.
